summary: Real Asset Acquisition Corp. (RAAQ), a SPAC, filed an 8-K on June 12, 2026, updating its pending business combination with IQM Finland Oy. The transaction, announced February 22, 2026, will result in IQM becoming publicly traded. The registration statement was declared effective on June 5, 2026, and RAAQ has mailed a definitive proxy statement/prospectus for an extraordinary general meeting. The filing includes a press release on IQM's board appointment. The deal is proceeding along a regulatory clock with shareholder vote scheduled. Key watch items: shareholder approval and closing conditions.
